name: highlight
title: Highlight
description: Marks the matched part of a result, so a list of hits shows WHY each one is a hit. Uses a real `<mark>`: the highlight is a semantic emphasis, not a colour, and a screen reader is entitled to know which words matched.
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/Highlight.json
